name: zk
description: Circom circuit proving Merkle-tree membership of a one-time purchase code, deriving a per-code nullifier.

scripts.setup:ptau:new: npx snarkjs powersoftau new bn128 14 build/pot14_0000.ptau -v
scripts.setup:ptau:contribute: npx snarkjs powersoftau contribute build/pot14_0000.ptau build/pot14_0001.ptau --name="contribution" -v -e="$(node -e 'console.log(require("crypto").randomBytes(32).toString("hex"))')"
scripts.setup:ptau:prepare: npx snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/pot14_0001.ptau build/pot14_final.ptau -v
scripts.setup:zkey:new: npx snarkjs groth16 setup build/purchase.r1cs build/pot14_final.ptau build/purchase_0000.zkey
scripts.setup:zkey:contribute: npx snarkjs zkey contribute build/purchase_0000.zkey build/purchase_final.zkey --name="key contribution" -v -e="$(node -e 'console.log(require("crypto").randomBytes(32).toString("hex"))')"
scripts.setup:zkey:verify: npx snarkjs zkey verify build/purchase.r1cs build/pot14_final.ptau build/purchase_final.zkey
scripts.setup:export: npx snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/purchase_final.zkey build/verification_key.json && npx snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/purchase_final.zkey build/Verifier.sol && cp build/Verifier.sol ../contract/src/Verifier.sol
